text:
Priya (Onboarding Lead): Hey all — kicking off Novus Retail onboarding. High-level target: pilot live in 30 days, formal handoff to Success Ops by day 45. Need to confirm: stakeholders, concrete success criteria, and immediate blockers. Can folks drop availability for a 30-min kickoff today/tomorrow?

Aisha (CSM): Available today 3-4pm PT or tomorrow 10-11am PT. I'll own weekly health checks and the 30/60/90 play.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow 10am PT works. We need Novus infra contacts (VPC, NAT, IP allowlist) before integration tasks.

Sam - Novus (Customer): 10am tomorrow works for me. Our infra team is EST and prefers afternoons — will confirm POC.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Thanks. Draft success criteria to align on during kickoff: 1) API integration + basic generation working in sandbox, 2) 95th pct latency <300ms for 512-token requests in Dedicated pilot, 3) Acceptance tests pass on a 10k sample prompt set, 4) Enablement session + docs delivered to product team, 5) Baseline usage metric defined for renewal signals. Anything to add?

Maya (Renewals): Add baseline MAU target and steady request rate (to avoid misleading bursty signals). Note: Novus has an internal cost review next quarter — potential renewal risk.

Aisha (CSM): I'll draft the 30/60/90 health plan and include MAU targets and a renewal_watch flag. Also propose an early pulse survey at day 14 for retention/feedback.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I’ll bring: API key provisioning, model pin (recommend redwood/llama-100b-quant for pilot), sample payloads, and a lightweight load-test plan. Quick sanity curl to run after key issued:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Priya (Onboarding Lead): @calendar-bot create 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 1:30pm ET / 10:30am PT. Agenda: intros, confirm success criteria, infra checklist, milestones & owners, migration risk if private required.

calendar-bot: Created event "Novus Retail — Onboard Kickoff" for 2026-04-14 13:30 ET. Invitees: Priya, Aisha, Marco, Sam, Liam, Maya.

Liam (Enablement): I'll prepare an enablement pack: quickstart walkthrough, sample prompts, troubleshooting doc, and a 45-min training we'll record. Recommend scheduling training for day 7 post-integration.

Sam - Novus (Customer): We have a labeled corpus ~12k retail prompts for acceptance tests. I'll share an S3 link before kickoff.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Action items:
- Sam: share infra POC and S3 prompts link (due before kickoff)
- Marco: publish tech checklist + load test template (due 1 day post-kickoff)
- Aisha: draft 30/60/90 health plan + MAU targets (due in 3 days)
- Liam: enablement pack + recording (ready by day 7)
- Maya: add renewal_watch tag in CRM and note cost-review window

Aisha (CSM): I’ll also add a short retention pulse survey at day 14 to capture early feedback and blockers.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Risk callout: if Novus requires private deployment (VPC/on-prem) early, timeline may extend by 3-4 weeks. @Sam please confirm preference by EOD tomorrow.

Sam - Novus (Customer): Prefer VPC peering long-term but can start in hosted sandbox for pilot. Will confirm EOD.

Maya (Renewals): Marking private-deploy preference as medium renewal risk until confirmed.

Marco (Solutions Eng): If VPC is needed, we’ll run an infra sync immediately after kickoff. We have a sandbox->private migration runbook.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Great. I’ll run the kickoff and share meeting notes + owner tracker after. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Aisha (CSM): Thanks, looking forward.

Liam (Enablement): +1 — will have the enablement roadmap ready.

Sam - Novus (Customer): See you at the kickoff.
